rulings.ruling: Ruling: helper of a branch this entry does not take; project retained. The loss line of a business with a profit, the Form 7206 lines of a business under which no plan is established, and the Pub. 946 two-limit helpers of a home office whose line 5 takes another branch are figured by the project but read by no line this entry reaches; the printed lines they would feed (line 31, Form 7206 lines 4 to 14 of the plan's business, line 30) agree. The model entered zero or its own figure for an unused helper. Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

The model multiplied net earnings by 15.3% at once; Schedule SE figures line 10 (12.4%) and line 11 (2.9%) separately, each rounded to the cent, and line 13 is half their sum (f1040sse lines 10 to 13), which gives the project's amount one cent higher. Not evidence.
